capabilities: Share documents and folders with collaborators in real time
Collaborate through a browser-based web editor without Obsidian
Connect AI agents to shared folders via MCP
Expose shared documents through a RESTful API
Sync changes automatically from external editors and AI tools

Pro or Business plan beyond 10 persistent shares

summary: Collaboration service that shares notes and folders with people, tools, and AI agents via real-time sync, a web editor, a REST API, and MCP.
